# Crypto Indicator Report Cards

**Do popular technical indicators actually predict direction?** We measured —
with no strategy, no backtest profits, no cherry-picking.

**Live report:** https://sungurerdim.github.io/indicator-cards/

<!-- AUTO-SCOPE:START (generated by scripts/gen_readme_inventory.py — do not edit by hand) -->
This dataset scores the raw directional accuracy of **60 popular technical indicator states** on **50 of the highest-volume Binance USDT-M perpetual futures pairs**, across **6 timeframes** (5m → 1d) and **2 forecast horizons** — up to **4 years** of history, **34,070 individual measurements**.
<!-- AUTO-SCOPE:END -->

> Repo layout: `index.html` (the whole report, self-contained) · `data/`
> (dataset + schema) · `scripts/` (build utilities) · `CITATION.cff` (how to cite)

## What makes it different

- **P&L-free.** No costs, no exits, no sizing — each indicator is judged only on
  whether its up/down state agreed with the price move that followed. This
  isolates *predictive skill* from strategy design.
- **No cherry-picking.** Every indicator × timeframe × horizon cell is published,
  including the failures. Negative results are the rarest public data in trading.
- **No look-ahead.** States are computed on closed candles only; forward returns
  start on the next bar.
- **One consistent source.** Every timeframe is an exact resample of raw
  5-minute Binance candles — no mixed feeds.

## How to read the numbers

| Metric | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Hit %** | share of candles where the indicator's direction matched the sign of the next-N-bar return |
| **Edge** | Hit % − 50 (0 ≈ coin flip) |
| **IC** | Spearman rank correlation between the indicator's continuous value and the forward return |

## Data

- [`data/dataset.json`](data/dataset.json) — the full dataset: per indicator ×
  timeframe × horizon, the per-coin rows
  `[symbol, edge_pp, ic_spearman, hit_pct, n_bars]`, plus the universe inventory
  (each pair's history span and bar count). Schema: [`data/SCHEMA.md`](data/SCHEMA.md).
- Universe: selected by 24h quote volume at collection time (index/stablecoin
  pairs excluded); the exact count and list live in the auto-generated
  inventory above. Newly listed pairs carry their full available history.

## Honest caveats

<!-- AUTO-CAVEAT:START (generated by scripts/gen_readme_inventory.py — do not edit by hand) -->
Results are period-specific — edges decay. A few cells out of 60 × 6 × 2 will look good by pure chance; judge patterns, not single cells. **This is not financial advice and not a trading strategy.**
<!-- AUTO-CAVEAT:END -->

## Rebuilding everything from scratch

The whole dataset is reproducible from public data with the code in this repo —
no private tooling involved:

```bash
pip install ccxt pandas scipy pyarrow

python3 scripts/fetch_candles.py --universe 50 1460   # raw 5m candles -> cache/ (~1 GB)
python3 scripts/measure.py                            # accuracy measurements -> build/skill.csv
python3 scripts/build_dataset.py                      # -> data/dataset.json
python3 scripts/embed_data.py                         # dataset + scope numbers -> index.html
python3 scripts/gen_readme_inventory.py               # scope numbers -> README
```

- `scripts/indicators.py` holds the exact math of all 33 states — the ground
  truth of what was measured.
- `measure.py` is incremental: re-running after a candle refresh only
  recomputes symbols whose data changed.
- Raw candles are deliberately **not** stored in git (~1 GB, and bulk exchange
  data is not ours to redistribute); `cache/` and `build/` are gitignored.
  Note: today's top-50-by-volume universe will differ from the one captured in
  the dataset — the universe list in `data/dataset.json` is the record of what
  was measured.
